messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Abnormal prefix cardinality detected for tenant 'sprintbank' on dedicated-pool-12 (us-east-1). Severity P1. Paging oncall.

zara (oncall): Ack. I'm seeing a sharp drop in prefix hit-rate and a matching increase in request latency for sprintbank. Attaching quick signal snapshot.

zara (oncall): symptoms: prefix hit-rate 88% -> 10% in ~12m; tails of token latency 25ms -> 240ms; evictions spiked to 900/s; customer facing API timeouts reported. No storage errors in KV backend.

leo (devops): Raw metrics: unique prefixes for tenant rose from ~3k to 145k in 10m on pool-12. That's huge. Any tenant-side batch job? Could be a client sending request ids in the prefix key.

jules (cs): Reached out to customer. They confirm they kicked off a large multi-region replay job, tooling might have included random IDs in the request path.

priya (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: high churn in per-worker prefix caches; LRU thrashing observed. Workers pinned to pool-12 are evicting hot entries repeatedly; CPU and mem stable but cache miss storms amplify work.

nate (infra): No infra-level incidents. Network and disk fine. We can add capacity but that only masks asymptotic blowup.

claire (support): Letting customer know we're investigating. Asking them to pause the replay if possible.

zara (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan (short timeline): 1) Enable tenant-level cache isolation (prevent their prefixes from entering shared LRU) 2) Run targeted eviction for ephemeral prefixes 3) Apply short-term quota on new prefixes 4) Scale pool-12 by +3 workers if safe. We'll coordinate steps and owners.

leo (devops): I'll flip the tenant isolation flag first (staged) to avoid global pollution. API call:

```
# isolate tenant namespace
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/cache/tenants/sprintbank/isolate
```

leo (devops): Rolling isolation to 3 workers, monitoring hit-rate.

priya (eng-runtime): Adding targeted eviction for these likely ephemeral prefixes: /sprintbank/replay-run/* and /sprintbank/tmp/* . Running eviction now.

```
# targeted eviction
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/cache/evict \
  -d '{"tenant":"sprintbank","prefixes":["/sprintbank/replay-run/","/sprintbank/tmp/"]}'
```

priya (eng-runtime): Eviction executed. Observed prefix hit-rate move from 10% -> 46% within 60s. Latency p50 dropped from 220ms -> 95ms.

nate (infra): Spun +3 workers on dedicated-pool-12 (healthy). Eviction pressure reduced, eviction rate down to ~60/s from 900/s.

jules (cs): Customer paused the replay job. They asked what caused this and how to prevent. I'll draft a timeline/message.

zara (oncall): Short-term throttling: apply quota rule to block >6k new prefixes in a 10min window for this tenant until we have permanent guardrails.

leo (devops): Quota API call:

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/quotas \
  -d '{"tenant":"sprintbank","rule":"max_new_prefixes","value":6000,"window_s":600}'
```

priya (eng-runtime): Also updating runtime routing: for requests that miss prefix cache above threshold, route to a low-cost fallback model to stop token-cost blowup and reduce latency impact:

```
redwoodctl routing set --tenant sprintbank --fallback tiny-gen-v1
```

claire (support): Notifying customer: "We've isolated your namespace, evicted ephemeral prefixes, and applied a temporary quota. Please keep replay paused while we stabilize."

jules (cs): Customer appreciative and wants a postmortem and recommendations. Scheduling a follow-up for tomorrow.

tom (sre): Action items for post-incident: 1) Default per-tenant namespace isolation toggle (tom/priya) 2) Instrument per-tenant new-prefix alarms and auto-throttle (tom/leo) 3) Update runbook for targeted eviction + commands (zara/leo) 4) Customer-facing KB entry about prefix best-practices (jules)

priya (eng-runtime): I've started an RCA doc. Preliminary root cause: customer replay inserted high-cardinality ephemeral suffixes into prefix keys, causing LRU cache pollution and thrash. Long-term mitigations: auto-isolate noisy tenants, better default quotas for new prefixes, and detect patterns like many unique suffix UUIDs.

zara (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing incident lead to priya for RCA and follow-up. priya please ack.

priya (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll monitor alerts and produce postmortem. Saving snapshots and logs (kv lookups, eviction traces).

zara (oncall): Incident status: mitigated. Page closed for paging rotation but thread stays open for postmortem notes. Good work, team. :white_check_mark:
